decisions.reason: The evening day-patient program extends the firm's core psychiatric treatment expertise, so its multidisciplinary teams can read early utilization and refine the offer, and its own page signals commitment.
The custom furniture carpentry builds on established workshop production and therapy know-how, so the firm can absorb market feedback and adjust it within its existing sheltered-work structure.
Outpatient sociotherapy sits close to the firm's mental health and outpatient support competence, so the firm can learn from early cases, though its low website visibility suggests modest priority.
Senior living counseling draws directly on the firm's eldercare knowledge, can be run at low cost, and its home-page placement shows strong strategic emphasis.

The retail shop extends the sheltered workshop's existing production, but retail is less tied to the firm's care knowledge and is only mentioned on the website, so it carries somewhat higher risk while still being worth keeping.
